title: One token's journey
intro: Every generated token makes this exact trip. Put the stops in order.
prompt: Order the steps of generating the next token:

steps.text: q/k/v projections produce Q for the new token (K, V of the past come from the cache)
Q is dotted with every K, scaled by √(key dim), softmaxed into attention weights
Weighted sum of the V vectors, passed through o_proj
The feed-forward network transforms each token's representation
The LM head scores every possible next token
Highest-scoring token is emitted, appended, and the whole pass repeats

debrief:
Tokens → embeddings → attention (Q·K → softmax → blend V) → FFN → LM head → append and repeat. The cache means steps 2–4 only compute fresh values for the NEW token; everything historical is a lookup.
